faqs.q: Where is Nimma's Dental Clinic in Kamareddy?
faqs.a: Nimma's Dental Clinic is beside Kaveri Udipi Hotel on the bypass junction corridor in Kamareddy, Telangana 503111. Parking is available for cars and two-wheelers.

faqs.q: What are the clinic timings and how do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Phone consultations are available from 9 am to 8 pm, and online appointment slots run from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM, Monday to Saturday. You can book on this website or call 88851 66165.

faqs.q: Who are the dentists at Nimma's Dental Clinic?
faqs.a: The clinic is led by Dr. Abhishek Reddy Nimma, an oral and maxillofacial surgeon (BDS, MDS), and Dr. Kranthi Nimma, a periodontist and aesthetic dentist (BDS, MDS).

faqs.q: Do you offer dental implants in Kamareddy?
faqs.a: Yes. Dr. Abhishek Reddy Nimma places titanium dental implants, using soft-tissue laser support to keep healing comfortable. An examination and X-ray decide whether implants suit your case.

Root canal treatment is done under local anaesthesia, so you should feel pressure rather than pain. The clinic offers micro-endodontic root canal treatment to remove deep infection and save the natural tooth.
Yes. The pedodontics service covers children's check-ups, sealants, fillings and fluoride treatment, with a gentle first visit so children feel at ease.

faqs.q: What cosmetic dentistry treatments are available?
faqs.a: Treatments include porcelain veneers, crowns, composite reshaping, laser teeth whitening (about 45 minutes), clear aligners and braces, and dental jewellery. Smile makeovers usually take 2 to 3 sessions.

faqs.q: Can I get an emergency dental appointment?
faqs.a: Yes. For tooth trauma, severe pain, swelling or urgent extractions, call 88851 66165 as soon as possible. Dr. Abhishek Reddy Nimma handles oral surgery and facial trauma cases.

faqs.q: How much does dental treatment cost?
faqs.a: The cost depends on your diagnosis and the treatment chosen. After your examination the dentist explains the options and gives you an estimate before treatment begins. Call 88851 66165 or book online to get started.

faqs.q: What does a laser dental procedure involve?
faqs.a: The clinic uses soft-tissue lasers for gum treatment and contouring. Laser work generally means less bleeding and swelling than a scalpel, and many procedures need little or no stitching.
